>>202. It would be hopeless for revolutionaries to try to attack the system
>>     without using SOME modern technology.  If nothing else they must use
>>     the communications media to spread their message.  But they should use 
>>     modern technology for only ONE purpose: to attack the technological 
>>     system.
>>
>so.....In order to stop RACISM you must become a racist?
>GOOD LOGIC THEIR GHOMER!!!!!!

You are trying too hard to not think.

Technology is powerful and therefore should be used at times to:

1. spread the message about the revolution
2. sabotage other types of technology
3. streamline the process of the revolution
4. infiltrate deeper into the technological system

This of course depends on what is the most appropriate tactic for a
specific goal.

-Ric
